name: 0001-distributed-url-shortener-with-analytics
description: > base62 ID generation under high write concurrency (avoid collisions without a single bottleneck — look at Postgres sequences vs. Snowflake-style IDs), a hot-path redirect service that must be fast (Redis cache in front of Postgres, cache invalidation on updates), and a click-analytics pipeline (batched writes, time-bucketed aggregation, maybe TimescaleDB/partitioned tables). Good for learning read/write splitting and caching strategy.
